transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get our pre-lock round-robin started so we can move toward final production approval on the gala broadcast package. As a quick recap of where the current draft stands: we're working with a three-camera setup, the recording will be reusable in the festival archive, we've got a sponsor product display on stage, and there's a general caption feed planned. The gala is Saturday evening at the Orpheum Theater — 900 seats — with the headliner in the final slot. Before I can sign off on the binding production approval, I need each of you — technical, rights, talent, and accessibility leads — to report your final operating requirements. Let's start with technical.
